name: seated lower trunk extensor lateral flexor stretch
description: Seated, you fold forward and sideways to stretch both the lower back and the side of your trunk. It targets one side at a time.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Fold forward and reach your hands toward one foot, letting your trunk bend slightly to that side.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
